description: Throttled FCP investigation, 2026-10-09. See docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-shell-load.md, section 'FCP investigation (throttled)'. Times in ms relative to navigation start.

method.browser: Playwright Chromium (headless), new context per (run, scenario, build); cold = first navigation in the context, warm = second navigation in the same context
method.throttlingNote: CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions (latency added per request; DNS/TCP/TLS not emulated) + Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate; login (once per profile) unthrottled
method.server: Node static server emulating deploy/nginx.conf: gzip level 1 for html/css/js/json incl. proxied /api JSON, 'max-age=31536000, public, immutable' for hashed assets, ETag/Last-Modified only for index.html, HTTP/1.1 over loopback 127.0.0.1
